header: What each endpoint costs per page
subheadline: Metering runs per page and per endpoint, so a document that is classified, split and then extracted shows up as three lines on the invoice. The rates below hold until a workspace crosses 100,000 pages in a month.

items.title: Field extraction
items.description: Invoices, delivery notes and forms returned as typed JSON with a confidence score on every field.

items.title: Document classification
items.description: Sorts a mixed inbox into 40 built-in document types, or into labels you define, before extraction runs.

items.title: PII redaction
items.description: Names, IBANs and card numbers masked in the stored file, with an audit entry written per document.
